title: Coherence Density
subtitle: Measuring internal coordination in complex adaptive systems.
audience: Complex systems researchers, modelers, and Active Inference practitioners studying organizational coordination.
lede: Coherence Density is an exploratory Ecosystem research project establishing a measurement-focused framework to quantify internal coordination, stability, and information flow in complex adaptive systems under Active Inference.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Coherence Density develops testable indicators and formal relationships to evaluate how internal organization and coordination are maintained while systems minimize free energy and adapt to uncertainty.

sections.heading: Participate
sections.body: Collaborators in complex systems, measurement modeling, and Active Inference theory are invited to review concepts, attend syncs, and contribute feedback.
